name: Revive and Hire
description: Near a downed teammate, hold R for 1 second to revive them in place. Near a downed enemy, hold R for 2 seconds to hire them—they switch to your team.

name: Jump Pads
description: Step on the glowing floor pads to launch yourself across the arena.

name: Occupy Enemy Territory
description: Push into the enemy home zone. Your team earns points every second you hold their territory, plus kills. First team to 1000 points wins.

name: Crouch Behind Cover
description: Hold C to duck behind obstacles. You stay in place—crouch is for cover, not for moving.
